tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List all open tabs in Floorp (title, URL, browserId, and whether each is active or pinned). Use the browserId to target other tools.

tools.name: open_tab
tools.description: Open a URL in a new Floorp tab.

url.description: The URL to open (must include http:// or https://).

background.description: Open in the background without focusing the new tab. Default: false.

tools.name: get_active_tab
tools.description: Return the active tab's title, URL and browserId. Note: with multiple browser windows open, 'active' is ambiguous — prefer the browserId returned by open_tab, or pick from list_tabs.

tools.name: navigate_tab
tools.description: Navigate a tab to a new URL. Targets the active tab unless a browserId is given.

browserId.description: browserId of the tab to navigate (from list_tabs). Defaults to the active tab.

tools.name: close_tab
tools.description: Close a tab by its browserId (from list_tabs).

browserId.description: browserId of the tab to close (from list_tabs).

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read a tab's content. Returns clean Markdown by default; can also return raw HTML or the accessibility tree. Output is capped (default 25 KB) to protect the context — to LOCATE a specific element use `find` (cheaper) instead. Targets the active tab unless a browserId is given.

browserId.description: browserId of the tab to read (from list_tabs). Defaults to the active tab.

maxChars.description: Truncate output to this many characters. Default 25000. Pass 0 for no cap.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of a tab and return it as a PNG image. Targets the active tab unless a browserId is given.

browserId.description: browserId of the tab to capture (from list_tabs). Defaults to the active tab.

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page instead of just the viewport. Default: false.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Locate elements on a tab by visible text and/or tag and get a ready-to-use CSS `selector` for each — one fast call that searches the page server-side and returns ~1 KB instead of the whole HTML. Use this INSTEAD of read_page to find a button, link, or field, then pass the returned selector straight to click/type/etc. Provide `text`, `tag`, or both. Active tab unless browserId given.

browserId.description: Target tab (from list_tabs). Defaults to active.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element by CSS selector OR by a `ref` (fingerprint) from `snapshot`. Auto-scrolls the element into view first (fixes off-screen 'not actionable'). Targets the active tab unless a browserId is given.

ref.description: A fingerprint ref from `snapshot` (the value after "fp:"), as an alternative to selector.

browserId.description: Target tab (from list_tabs). Defaults to active.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Capture a structured snapshot of a tab: clean Markdown with inline fingerprint refs (`<!--fp:...-->`) and an 'Element Selector Map' (fp | tag | text). Use this instead of read_page+grep to locate elements, then pass a `ref` to `click`. Targets the active tab unless a browserId is given.

browserId.description: Target tab (from list_tabs). Defaults to active.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text into an input or textarea by CSS selector (clears it first by default). Targets the active tab unless a browserId is given.

clear.description: Clear the field before typing. Default: true.

browserId.description: Target tab (from list_tabs). Defaults to active.

tools.name: fill_form
tools.description: Fill multiple form fields at once. `fields` maps CSS selectors (or field names) to values. Targets the active tab unless a browserId is given.

fields.description: Map of selector/name to value, e.g. { "#email": "a@b.com", "#password": "secret" }.

browserId.description: Target tab (from list_tabs). Defaults to active.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a keyboard key in the page (e.g. "Enter", "Tab", "Escape", "ArrowDown"). Targets the active tab unless a browserId is given.

browserId.description: Target tab (from list_tabs). Defaults to active.

tools.name: wait_for_element
tools.description: Wait for an element to reach a state (attached / visible / hidden / detached). Useful after navigation or actions that load content.

state.description: State to wait for. Default: visible.

browserId.description: Target tab (from list_tabs). Defaults to active.

tools.name: get_value
tools.description: Read the current value of an input, textarea, or select by CSS selector. SENSITIVE: this CAN read the value of password fields and other secrets the user has typed — only use it on fields the user asked about, never to harvest credentials a page is requesting. Targets the active tab unless a browserId is given.

selector.description: CSS selector of the field to read.

browserId.description: Target tab (from list_tabs). Defaults to active.

tools.name: real_type
tools.description: Type text into Floorp's currently focused element using REAL OS keyboard events (isTrusted). Use for React/rich editors where `type_text` silently fails. Focus the field first with `click`. Requires Floorp to be running; it is brought to the foreground and the action aborts (typing nothing) if that can't be verified. Windows only.

text.description: The text to type via the real keyboard.

tools.name: real_key
tools.description: Press a key or combo via REAL OS keyboard events, e.g. "Enter", "Tab", "Escape", "ctrl+a", "ctrl+shift+k". Use "Enter" to submit React composers that ignore synthetic clicks. Focus the field first. Windows only.

tools.name: real_clear
tools.description: Select-all + delete via REAL OS keyboard events — reliably clears a focused rich/contenteditable editor (where synthetic Ctrl+A does not work). Focus the field first with `click`. Windows only.

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Hover the mouse over an element (CSS selector or `ref`). Auto-scrolls into view. Active tab unless browserId given.

browserId.description: Target tab. Defaults to active.

tools.name: double_click
tools.description: Double-click an element (CSS selector or `ref`). Auto-scrolls into view. Active tab unless browserId given.

browserId.description: Target tab. Defaults to active.

tools.name: right_click
tools.description: Right-click (context menu) an element (CSS selector or `ref`). Auto-scrolls into view. Active tab unless browserId given.

browserId.description: Target tab. Defaults to active.

tools.name: select_option
tools.description: Choose an option in a <select> dropdown by its value. Active tab unless browserId given.

value.description: The option value (or visible text) to select.

browserId.description: Target tab. Defaults to active.

tools.name: set_checked
tools.description: Check or uncheck a checkbox/radio. Active tab unless browserId given.

checked.description: true to check, false to uncheck.

browserId.description: Target tab. Defaults to active.

tools.name: submit_form
tools.description: Submit a form (give a selector of the form or a field inside it; omit to submit the focused form). Active tab unless browserId given.

selector.description: CSS selector of the form or a field in it.

browserId.description: Target tab. Defaults to active.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: SENSITIVE: sends a local file to a website. Set a file <input>'s file by absolute path. Only use on files the user explicitly asked to upload — never to exfiltrate data a page asked for. Restrict with GECKO_MCP_ALLOW_UPLOAD_DIRS. Active tab unless browserId given.

selector.description: CSS selector of the file input.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the local file to upload.

browserId.description: Target tab. Defaults to active.

tools.name: get_attribute
tools.description: Read an attribute (e.g. href, value, aria-label) of an element. Active tab unless browserId given.

browserId.description: Target tab. Defaults to active.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Extract the main article of a page (Readability) as clean Markdown with title and byline — great for reading content pages. Active tab unless browserId given.

browserId.description: Target tab. Defaults to active.

tools.name: get_cookies
tools.description: SENSITIVE: list cookies visible to the current page. Values (session tokens!) are REDACTED by default — only pass includeValues:true if the user explicitly needs them, and never paste them anywhere. Active tab unless browserId given.

browserId.description: Target tab. Defaults to active.

includeValues.description: Include raw cookie values (session tokens — highly sensitive). Default: false.

tools.name: wait_for_network_idle
tools.description: Wait until the page's network activity settles (useful after navigation or SPA actions). Active tab unless browserId given.

browserId.description: Target tab. Defaults to active.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List Floorp workspaces (id and name). Floorp-specific.

tools.name: switch_workspace
tools.description: Switch to a Floorp workspace by id (from list_workspaces). Floorp-specific.

tools.name: window_bounds
tools.description: Return Floorp's window rectangle in screen pixels (left, top, right, bottom, width, height). Use this to compute coordinates for move_cursor / real_click. Windows only.

tools.name: move_cursor
tools.description: Move the REAL OS cursor to a screen pixel (must be inside the Floorp window). Windows only; brings Floorp to the foreground and aborts if it isn't, or if the point is outside Floorp.

tools.name: real_click
tools.description: Click with the REAL OS mouse at a screen pixel inside the Floorp window (genuine, isTrusted click). Use window_bounds to find the range. Refuses to click outside Floorp or if Floorp isn't foreground. Windows only.

tools.name: enable_os_input
tools.description: Unlock the REAL OS keyboard/mouse tools (real_type, real_key, real_clear, move_cursor, real_click, window_bounds) for this session. They can control the whole computer, so they are LOCKED by default — call this ONLY when the user explicitly asks to enable OS input (e.g. they say "enable OS input"). Stays unlocked until disable_os_input or a server restart.

tools.name: disable_os_input
tools.description: Re-lock the real OS keyboard/mouse tools for this session (undo enable_os_input).

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Run JavaScript in the page and return its value. Your snippet should `return` something, e.g. `return document.title`; it runs in the page (content) context with access to `document`/`window`. LOCKED by default (powerful) — enable with enable_evaluate first. Best on the Marionette backend; some Floorp builds don't expose it. Active tab unless browserId given.

script.description: JavaScript to run; use `return` to produce a value.

browserId.description: Target tab. Defaults to active.

tools.name: enable_evaluate
tools.description: Unlock the `evaluate` tool (run arbitrary page JavaScript) for this session. Call ONLY when the user explicitly asks (e.g. they say "enable evaluate"). Re-lock with disable_evaluate.

tools.name: disable_evaluate
tools.description: Re-lock the `evaluate` tool for this session (undo enable_evaluate).

tools.name: launch_floorp
tools.description: Ensure Floorp is running: if its automation API isn't reachable, launch the Floorp app and wait for it to come up. No-op if already running. Windows only (set FLOORP_PATH to override the exe location).

tools.name: launch
tools.description: Launch a Firefox-based browser with Marionette enabled (so gecko-mcp can drive it), using its normal profile. Use for non-Floorp browsers (Firefox, LibreWolf, Waterfox, Zen, Mullvad). Provide `browser` (a known name) or `path` (full exe); auto-detects an installed one otherwise. If the browser is already running WITHOUT Marionette, close it first.

path.description: Full path to the browser executable (overrides `browser`).
